description: This is a FastAPI-based backend API source file for a Notes application. It defines REST endpoints for CRUD operations on notes and tags, including listing, creating, updating, deleting, and searching with filters. The file sets up the FastAPI app, middleware, and route handlers, and interacts with domain flows and models for core logic.
